notes: Retrospective exploratory analysis on the already exposed 64-scene, 38-recording NAVTEST development panel, not independent testing.
Primary input is the original public DrivoR generator's own 64 candidates and its scorer in the complete standalone64 attention context.
TOAD-released generated64 is a within-panel secondary check with the same original DrivoR scorer, not another scorer method.
Candidate set and observed scene predictors use no future frames or official future labels. Current GT annotations are diagnostic metadata, not model input.
Thresholds and predictor list are recorded before this new association analysis; hypotheses were informed by earlier analyses of this same panel.
No semantic intersection, occlusion, or traffic-light labels are invented from images. Actor distance means current GT center distance, not clearance or TTC.
